title: Git and PR briefing
sourcePrompt: Choose a Git repository to catch up on its commits and PR descriptions. An ontology is optional.
webTitle: Git and PR briefing needs the installed app
webBody: Choose a repository folder in the installed app to read local Git history and create an explanation with your connected model.
sourceUnavailable: This repository is unavailable or its folder permission expired. Choose it again; your dates are kept.
noHistory: This folder has no readable Git history. Choose another repository or retry after its first commit.
loading: Reading the selected repository and period…
readError: Could not read Git history. Your repository and dates are kept; try again.
empty: No commits were found in this period. Choose another period.
evidenceReady: The local history is ready. Read its sources or create an explanation.
scope: Current branch, first-parent commits, using the shown local dates. Merged branch commits are not counted separately; uncommitted changes are excluded.
partialHistory: Some Git history could not be read within the limit. Counts cover returned evidence; narrow the dates to read more.
prTransfer: GitHub receives {repository} and the selected commit IDs or PR numbers. Commit messages and file contents are not uploaded by this read.
prNotRequested: PR descriptions have not been requested. You can explain the local commit messages or read PR descriptions first.
prUnsupported: PR reading currently supports public github.com repositories. Local commit messages remain available.
prRefreshFailed: Could not refresh PR descriptions. Previously read versions and your explanation are kept; they have not been refreshed. Retry when ready.
prRateLimited: GitHub has temporarily limited PR requests. Your local commit messages remain available.
prRetryAt: GitHub asks you to retry after {time}. Atlas will not retry automatically.
prRetryUnknown: GitHub did not provide a usable retry time. Try again later.
prUnavailable: Could not read these PR descriptions. Access, network or rate limits may be the cause; keep the local sources or retry.
noPr: No matching merged PR was found for the commits checked. This does not prove that the repository has no PRs.
prPartial: PR lookup is incomplete. Only the descriptions read so far are available; some commits remain unchecked.
prUnlinked: This PR could not be tied to the selected history. Its description is excluded from the explanation.
commitOnlyNote: Commit messages may omit reasons, checks and limits.
transfer: {model} at {destination} will receive the previewed commit messages, matched PR descriptions, source IDs and period. Code contents and ontology documents are excluded.
packet: Analysis includes {commits} commits and {prs} PR descriptions · {bytes} bytes.
modelUnavailable: No connected text model is available. Check Models in Settings, or keep reading the sources.
modelLimit: This model cannot accept the selected text. Keep your sources and narrow the dates or choose another connected model.
analyzing: Creating an explanation from the shown sources…
cancelled: Stopped. Sources and dates are kept. Text already sent to the model cannot be recalled.
analysisFailed: The model did not return an explanation. Sources and dates are kept; try again.
invalidAnalysis: The explanation could not be matched to its sources. Read the sources or try again.
noExplanation: The included descriptions do not support a useful explanation. Read the sources or choose another period.
auditFailed: The transfer record could not be completed, so this result is not shown. This request may have been sent. Check disk space and recording-folder access before retrying.
stale: The repository or source descriptions changed. Refresh the sources before creating a new explanation.
partialAnalysis: This explanation covers only part of the collected sources. Narrow the dates to include more.
coverage: {included} of {collected} collected commits included · {prs} matched PR descriptions.
attribution: Based on commit and PR descriptions. Atlas has not independently verified their behavior or test claims.
reasonMissing: The included descriptions do not state a reason.
checksMissing: The included descriptions do not state which checks ran.
limitsMissing: The included descriptions do not state remaining limits. This is not evidence that none remain.
excluded: {count} collected source records were not included in this explanation.
sourceUnavailableInline: This source text is unavailable or incomplete. It cannot support an explanation; other sources remain readable.
ontologyNote: These are current recorded concepts. They do not determine the briefing or verify historical behavior.
prSnapshotNote: This is the PR description as fetched, which may differ from what it said when merged.
remoteSelection: Choose the public GitHub repository whose PR descriptions you want to read.
unexplained: {count} included source records were not explained. Read them alongside this partial explanation.
sourceAudit: Connection checks and briefing transfers are recorded in Atlas app data on this device. These records contain transfer metadata, not repository text.
overviewIntro: Bring together the changes, reasons and remaining problems recorded in commits and PRs.
preparing: Checking the model and preparing your source preview…
cancelling: Stopping… Your sources and dates are kept.
readPrHelp: PR descriptions can add the reasons and checks missing from merge messages.
readPeriodCode: Read code changes for the whole period
claimsNote: Based on author records · open a citation to check the original.
prCancelled: PR reading stopped. Local sources and dates are kept.
rejectedResponseNote: This response was not accepted as an explanation. It is kept only in this screen memory and is not saved to disk.
incompleteAnalysis: The explanation was too long to finish. Your sources and dates are kept. Narrow the dates and try again.
recordingGaps: Check the original records for items missing from this explanation. An omitted explanation does not mean no problems remain.
languageMismatch: The model did not use the screen language. Your sources and dates are kept; try again.
checksOriginal: Author validation is quoted directly from the cited records.
periodPlan: Send {commits} commit messages and {prs} PR descriptions in {parts} reading requests, one at a time.
periodReadingBytes: Reading requests send {bytes} bytes in total.
periodOverviewPlan: One final request will use up to {bytes} bytes of selected original passages to create the overview.
periodSinglePart: This period fits in one reading request. Its explanation will be the overview.
periodSessionOnly: Generated explanations and progress clear when you close Atlas.
periodUnsendable: {count} source records cannot be sent. Read their reasons below; the other records remain in the plan.
periodStopping: Stopping the current request. Completed parts remain available.
periodStopped: Stopped after {completed} of {parts} parts. Continue to read the remaining parts; completed explanations are kept.
periodPartFailed: Part {number} failed. Completed parts, sources and dates are kept. Retry this part to continue.
periodSynthesizing: Creating the overview from selected original passages…
periodOverviewFailed: The overview failed. Completed part explanations remain available. Retry only the overview or read the parts.
periodOverviewCoverage: Overview request sources: {selected} of {candidates} original passages · {represented} of {parts} parts included.
periodOverviewPartial: Some supported passages are outside this overview. Read the completed parts for the remaining work and author-recorded limits.
periodCoverage: {completed} of {parts} parts completed · {sent} of {collected} source records sent · {linked} cited in part explanations.
periodGaps: {unexplained} sent records remain unexplained · {unsent} records not sent · {uncertain} delivery unconfirmed. Sending a record does not mean it was fully explained.
periodFinished: All planned parts are finished. Check coverage and the original records for omissions.
periodPartial: This period explanation is partial. Some history, PR lookup, records or explanations are missing. Read the coverage details.
periodOverlarge: This complete record exceeds the current request limit. It was not sent; read the original source.
periodIncomplete: The complete source text is unavailable. It was not sent; refresh the sources or read the available original.
periodUnexplained: Sent, but not cited in a completed part explanation. Read its original source.
periodStale: The sources, period, model, model capacity or screen language changed. Completed parts stay under their original settings. Prepare a new plan before continuing.
periodNoOverview: The completed parts did not produce supported claims for an overview. Read the original sources or choose another period.
periodOverviewPolicy: The overview selects one change passage per part first, then recorded limits, reasons, other changes and checks. Passages that do not fit stay listed below.
prSavedPolicy: Atlas saves the public PR descriptions you ask it to read on this device: one version per PR, up to 400 copies or 16 MiB. Older reads are removed first. Saved text and repository visibility may have changed on GitHub. You can clear all saved PR copies below.
prSavedLoading: Checking saved PR copies on this device…
prSavedNone: No saved PR originals for this period.
prSavedReady: Opened {count} saved PR descriptions. GitHub has not been checked.
prSavedUnchecked: PRs for {count} commits have not been checked in this read. Saved copies are not a complete PR lookup.
prSavedOmitted: {count} more saved PR descriptions match this period but exceed the read limit. Narrow the dates to open them.
prSavedIgnored: {count} saved PR descriptions failed local checks and were not opened. Read GitHub again to replace them.
prSavedUnavailable: Could not open saved PR copies safely. Read GitHub again for this period, or clear the saved copies and try again.
prSavedUnsupported: Saving PR copies is unavailable on this system. You can read GitHub now; those originals will last only for this app session.
prSavedSaving: Saving these PR descriptions on this device…
prSavedUpdated: Saved {count} PR descriptions on this device. Choose the same repository and period to reopen them after restarting Atlas.
prSaveFailed: Could not update saved PR copies. This read stays available in this app session; earlier saved versions may remain after restart. Check storage access, then read GitHub again or clear saved copies.
prSaveTooLarge: {count} PR descriptions exceed the saved-copy limit. They remain available for this app session; read GitHub again to retrieve them later.
prSavedEvicted: Removed {count} older saved PR copies to stay within the storage limit. Read GitHub again if you need them.
prSavedClearScope: Clears saved PR copies for every repository on this device. Open originals and explanations stay in this app session; repositories, ontology folders and transfer records are unchanged.
prSavedCleared: Saved PR copies cleared. Originals already open remain available for this app session. A new GitHub read can save them again.
prClearFailed: Could not clear all saved PR copies. Some may remain on this device. Check storage access, then try again.
prSavedNotice: Read PR originals are saved on this device (up to 400 copies / 16 MiB).
prSaveSuperseded: A newer PR read or clear started. These originals remain in this app session; saved copies were not replaced.
summaryEmptyBody: Read the originals, or create a summary.
summaryModelMissing: Choose a local model to create a summary. You can read the originals now.
summaryStale: Summary from earlier sources or settings
savedPrStatus: Saved PRs · latest GitHub content unchecked
previewSourceCount: {commits, plural, one {# commit message} other {# commit messages}} · {prs, plural, one {# PR description} other {# PR descriptions}}
previewSourceScope: Source IDs and dates are included. Code and ontology documents are excluded.
previewOverview: Reads in parts, then sends up to {bytes} bytes of selected originals for the overview.
